name: Sydney Winbush

last_movies.title: 权欲第二章 第四季

introduction: Sydney Winbush is an American actress known for her roles in Starz's Power Book 2: Ghost (2024), Hulu's Shrill (2020), Disney's Timmy Failure (2020) and the Netflix original series, Trinkets (2020). Born in Heidelberg, Germany as a military kid, Sydney's love for acting was apparent at a young age. She began her career in Portland, Oregon and quickly became a member of SAG. In October 2020, Sydney relocated to Los Angeles, California where she can be seen acting, writing and content creating.
